schema_sql:
CREATE TABLE account (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), cash TEXT,
            initial TEXT, halted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE intents (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, hash TEXT NOT NULL,
            candidate TEXT NOT NULL, lots INTEGER NOT NULL, reserved TEXT NOT NULL,
            state TEXT NOT NULL, created TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE fills (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, intent TEXT NOT NULL,
            leg INTEGER NOT NULL, side TEXT NOT NULL, units INTEGER NOT NULL,
            price TEXT NOT NULL, fee TEXT NOT NULL, stamp TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE events (seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL,
            payload TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE metadata (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)
